streifenlaenge_routing_hinter_der_platte: Strip length, routing behind the plate and printable templates for LED neon signs.
der_code_enthaelt_alle_einstellungen: The code contains all settings and manual edits. Uploaded fonts are only included in the file ("Save").
der_streifen_laeuft_innen_an: The strip runs along the inside of every letter outline.
der_streifen_folgt_dem_strich: The strip follows the stroke of the letters.
zu_enge_stellen_automatisch_glaetten: Smooth spots that are too tight
ohne_diese_option_folgt_der: Without this option the strip follows the lettering exactly; only real corners are rounded with the bend radius and spots that are too tight are marked red. With it, everything tighter than the smoothing radius is smoothed – the strip deviates from the lettering (marked blue).
punkte_i_j_ae_oe: Dots (i, j, ä, ö, ü, punctuation)
eigenes_stueck_uebergang_hinter_der: Separate piece, transition behind the plate
eigenes_stueck_mit_eigenem_kabel: Separate piece with its own cable
gilt_vorne_und_hinter_der: Applies at the front and behind the plate
zwischen_zwei_stuecken_taucht_der: Between two pieces the strip dives through a hole to the back and comes back through the next one. The minimum bend radius applies behind the plate as well.
jedes_stueck_wird_einzeln_abgeschnitten: Every piece is cut separately and wired behind the plate.
led_im_brett_versenken: Recess the LED into the board
nein_streifen_liegt_auf_der: No – strip lies on the plate
teile_die_komplett_von_ausschnitten: Parts that would be completely enclosed by cut-outs (e.g. the inside of o, a, e, D) are held by bridges. At a bridge the strip is interrupted and runs behind the board.
mit_tatsaechliche_groesse_100_drucken: Print at "actual size / 100 %", trim the sheets along the cut lines and glue them at the blue glue areas. Every sheet has a 10 cm check scale.
beim_ersten_start_werden_ca: About 15 MB are loaded on first start, afterwards everything comes from the browser cache.
ecke_gerade_gerade: Corner (straight – straight) – bent with the bend radius
gerade_bogen_eckig: Straight → curve, corner – bent with the bend radius
bogen_gerade_eckig: Curve → straight, corner – bent with the bend radius
bogen_bogen_eckig: Curve → curve, corner – bent with the bend radius
vorne_hinten_durchfuehrungen_auf_raster: front + back + passes, rounded to the cut pitch
n_lose_teile_gesichert_mit: · {n} loose parts held by {b} bridges (green in the "cut-outs" view); the strip is interrupted there.
manuelle_aenderungen_wurden_verworfen_we: Manual edits were discarded because the font or geometry parameters changed.
keine_datei_des_led_neon: Not a LED neon planner file
die_gespeicherte_eigene_schrift_ist: The saved custom font is not part of the code. Please upload it again.
kopieren_nicht_moeglich_bitte_manuell: Copying not possible – please select manually.
link_enthaelt_kein_gueltiges_layout: The link does not contain a valid layout.
strichstaerke_auto: automatic: thin for single line, bold for outline
strichstaerke_hint: Thin weights give cleaner centre lines for single-line laying.
editor_hint: Drag points · double-click a point: round ↔ corner · hover a point: point type · double-click a path: insert point · Del: delete piece · Ctrl+Z: undo
